name: dsh
notes: Official DeepSeek Harness (dsh), resolved from the @deepseek-ai npm scope at install time — not the old dsh-mini repack. Runs natively on Bionic. Four Termux adaptations: (1) a NODE_OPTIONS --require preload reports process.platform as 'linux', because Node says 'android' on Termux and dsh-subprocess-local's process inspector rejects anything but linux/darwin; NODE_OPTIONS is used so the override also reaches worker_threads, which get a fresh process object. (2) node-pty is compiled from source against Termux pty.h/libutil, since the published linux-arm64 prebuild is glibc-linked. (3) koffi, sharp and sherpa-onnx are stubbed — no Android build exists and none is reachable on Linux except sharp. (4) install runs with --ignore-scripts so koffi's cnoke build and node-pty's node-gyp fallback do not run. Landlock sandboxing probes as unavailable on this kernel and dsh runs unsandboxed, which is upstream's documented fail-closed path. Re-run the recipe to upgrade to a newer release.
